subsystems.name: Reprogramming payload
subsystems.role: the instructions that push a cell back toward a younger state.
parts: OSK or OSKM factors (Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, optionally c-Myc)
or CRISPR activation machinery that switches on the cell's own copies of those genes
promoter and microRNA elements that keep it transient and skin-specific

subsystems.name: Delivery vehicle
subsystems.role: carries the payload into skin cells without integrating into the genome.
parts: ionisable lipid nanoparticles wrapped around mRNA
or electroporation of cells outside the body

subsystems.name: Dose controller
subsystems.role: makes the reset partial and reversible rather than a full reprogramming into stem cells.

subsystems.name: Measurement stack
subsystems.role: proves the cells are biologically younger, not just different.

subsystems.name: Manufacturing
parts: lipid nanoparticle formulation and sterile fill

buildSteps.title: Pick the cargo
buildSteps.detail: Choose which factors to use and whether to supply them as mRNA or to turn on the cell's own genes with a CRISPR activation system, since only the second keeps the cell's natural gene regulation intact.

buildSteps.title: Engineer the cassette
buildSteps.detail: Build a DNA or RNA template with strong expression, short half-life and skin-cell targeting, so the factors act for days, not indefinitely.

buildSteps.title: Produce the nucleic acid
buildSteps.detail: Synthesise mRNA by in-vitro transcription with modified nucleosides to avoid immune alarm, or package the cassette into an AAV vector.

buildSteps.title: Formulate for skin
buildSteps.detail: Encapsulate the payload in lipid nanoparticles sized for intradermal injection or, for ex vivo work, deliver it to biopsied fibroblasts by electroporation.

buildSteps.title: Test in human skin cells
buildSteps.detail: Apply the payload to aged human fibroblasts and skin explants, then read DNA methylation age, proliferation, collagen output and the absence of stem-cell markers.

buildSteps.title: Pulse the dose in animals
buildSteps.detail: Give short cycles rather than continuous exposure, which is how partial reprogramming was shown to improve tissue function in mice without forming tumours.

buildSteps.title: Safety screen
buildSteps.detail: Check for teratoma formation, off-target edits, immune reactions and any loss of cell identity before human use.

buildSteps.title: Clinical testing
buildSteps.detail: Dose human volunteers, biopsy treated skin, and measure both molecular age markers and visible endpoints such as wrinkle depth and wound healing.

prerequisites.why: the four Yamanaka factors and their behaviour are the foundation of the whole approach.
short pulses of the factors were shown in 2016 to rejuvenate tissues in mice and extend healthspan in a premature-ageing model, but only in animals.
DNA methylation clocks, developed from 2013 onwards, give an objective readout of biological age.
a catalytically dead Cas9 fused to activators can raise gene expression without cutting DNA.
mRNA in lipid nanoparticles or AAV can reach skin cells, but efficiency, repeat dosing and immune clearance are not yet solved.

prerequisites.tech: Evidence that resetting improves human skin
prerequisites.why: no controlled human trial has yet shown a clinical benefit.

pathway.milestone: rejuvenation of human skin cells in culture and of aged skin in mice, with several biotech groups pursuing mRNA-based reprogramming for dermatology
pathway.unlocks: proof that partial resetting is measurable and dose-controllable.

pathway.milestone: first-in-human safety studies, likely as an aesthetic or wound-healing treatment
pathway.unlocks: real data on duration, immune response and reversibility in people.

pathway.milestone: controlled trials with biopsy-verified age markers and visible skin endpoints
pathway.unlocks: the first regulated product if benefits outweigh the tumour risk.

pathway.milestone: extension of the same dosing logic to other tissues and organs
pathway.unlocks: regenerative medicine beyond skin — if safe delivery and long-term safety hold up.
